records.summary: Extended Coinbase/Morpho collateral research into the liquidation-to-redemption pathway. Verified Coinbase's official cbXRP deposit auto-unwrap mechanism, indexed 132 historical cbXRP/USDC liquidation events for one Base liquidator, captured a 701.6 cbXRP seizure within a 30-action batch, and confirmed separate 62.5% and 77% LLTV markets. No liquidator-to-Coinbase redemption or native XRP sale was traced.
actions: Verified Coinbase's official 1:1 cbXRP backing and automatic cbXRP-to-native-XRP credit on eligible Coinbase Exchange deposits.
Recorded 132 cbXRP/USDC Morpho liquidations attributed to address 0x4c0f…19f4, with $1.07478M USDC debt repaid and $136.24K bonus during its Sep 13–Oct 8 activity window.
Recorded one 701.6 cbXRP seizure for 829.4 USDC debt and $105.09 bonus within a 30-action batch; retained proceeds are not measured.
Identified a separate 77% LLTV cbXRP/USDC market alongside the 62.5% market and separated market IDs, vault allocations and underlying liquidity.
Reviewed Morpho public REST API documentation; API execution remains not performed.
blockers: No transfer from identified liquidators to Coinbase Exchange deposit addresses was observed.
No cbXRP unwrap/burn and native XRP credit linked to the liquidations was traced.
No subsequent native XRP CEX sale was attributed to seized collateral.
Coinbase has not disclosed which Morpho market IDs its interface routes through.
Morpho API public reads and historical pagination have not been executed.
next_actions: Trace 0x4c0f and 0xa5e989 cbXRP balances and transfers after liquidations using the official Base cbXRP contract.
Look for Coinbase Exchange cbXRP deposit/unwrap events linked to those liquidators; do not infer identity from address proximity.
Reconcile 62.5% and 77% market IDs, oracles, LLTVs, supply/borrow, collateral at risk and curator/vault exposure.
Execute read-only Morpho REST API queries and validate pagination, timestamps and rate limits.
Keep liquidation/unwrap metrics separate from spot-market supply and Coinbase product volume.
